title: Store Service State
description: What a board remembers between runs — keyed, durable, and scoped to the board. (Runtimes: node; IDs: store)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

namespace.description: Which of the board's tables. Empty is the board's own

key.description: The key to act on, when every pass means the same slot

keyFrom.description: Dotted path into the input to take the key from, e.g. meta.messageId

valueFrom.description: Dotted path to the part worth keeping; the whole input by default

limit.description: list: how many records to take, oldest first. 0 = all

lastCount.description: Read-only: what the last pass saw
